details: Forum topic 95 (1.0.58): zones (fixed 100-channel blocks) could not be seen or chosen, and the radio scanned every channel together. Stock CHIRP StaticBankModel sized banks with '/', raising TypeError, so the bridge dropped the zone model for 13 fixed-zone radios. Scanning across zones is controlled by the radio's Scan Zone Linking / Scan Link Zone 1-10 settings, which NewChirp exposes.
summary: Zones not shown; radio scans all channels as one zone
